name: Pixel Firmware Formats
description: Container Browser support for Pixel/Tensor vendor firmware formats: FBPACK (bootloader/radio), ext4, Shannon baseband TOC, and Android self-extracting vendor blobs.
longdescription: Adds Container Browser transforms for the firmware formats found in Pixel/Tensor vendor blobs that Binary Ninja's core does not already parse: FBPACK v1/v2 (Fastboot Package, used by bootloader.img/radio.img), ext4 (vendor.img/vendor_dlkm.img, including the boot-pad-less variant seen inside modem images), Samsung Shannon baseband TOC firmware (modem.bin), and the self-extracting shell-script wrapper used to distribute vendor blobs. Pure Python, no external tool or GPL dependency required.
author: Bradley Fernandez
